title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Announce Recall of Snowmobiles
summary: The starter ring gear may crack, causing fragmentation and debris, which may act as a projectile at high speeds. A projectile could cause serious injury or death. Units: About 1,613.

title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Announce Recall of Snowmobiles
summary: The throttle lever could become stuck, leading to loss of speed control and possible collision. Units: About 3,163.

title: CPSC, IKEA Home Furnishings Announce Recall of Fargglad Multi-Color Children's Chair
summary: Choking hazard from red plastic feet that can detach from chair legs. Units: 7,279.

title: CPSC, Sky High International Announce Recall of Care Bears Lunch Kits Sold at Kohl's Department Stores
summary: The pull-up drinking spout can detach from the bottle, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 13,000.

title: CPSC, Giant Bicycle Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
summary: The front brake mounting tabs can break, causing the brakes to fail and the rider to lose control of the bicycle. Units: About 160.

title: CPSC, LaCrosse Footwear, Inc. Announce Recall of Work Boots
summary: The protective toe cap on the boots may not provide sufficient impact and compression protection. This could result in crushing, bruising, or other injury to the wearer's foot. Units: About 8,400.

title: CPSC, Little Giant Pump Co. Announce Recall of Cooler Pumps
summary: The motor caps on the cooler pumps are not made with flame-retardant material and an internal electrical failure can ignite the cap, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 150,000.

title: CPSC, Chicago Wholesale & Imports Inc. Announce Recall of Electric Pictures
summary: These pictures have inadequate construction, incorrect wiring, and use flammable materials, all of which pose fire and electric shock hazards to consumers. Units: 3,500.

title: CPSC, Teng Fei Trading Inc. Announce Recall of Energy Saving Light Bulbs
summary: The base of the bulb is not flame-retardant, as required in the voluntary standard for this type of bulb. Electrical components in the bulb can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 81,000.

title: CPSC, Dell Inc. Announce Recall of AC Adapters for Notebook Computers
summary: The adapters can overheat, posing a risk of fire and electrical shock hazards to consumers. Units: About 990,000.

title: CPSC, New York Zion Trading Corp. Announce Recall of Electric Fans
summary: The wiring is undersized and the power plug is not polarized, creating fire and shock hazards. Units: About 2,500.

title: CPSC, Runtal North America Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Runtal Sundance Towel Radiators
summary: The towel rack may overheat and rupture when overloaded with towels, releasing heated fluid, which could result in a burn injury. Units: 200.

title: CPSC, Kyocera Wireless Corp. Announce Recall of Cell Phone Batteries
summary: Some of the cell phone batteries supplied by the battery manufacturer may be counterfeit. This can cause the batteries to short-circuit, overheat and pose burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1 million.

title: CPSC, Rio Brands Announce Recall of Folding Lawn Chairs Sold at Wal-Mart
summary: The chair arms can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 20,700.

title: CPSC, International Playthings, Inc. Announce Recall of Rattles
summary: The spiral section of the rattle can come apart, releasing small balls inside. This can pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,600.

title: CPSC, Nexgrill Industries Announce Recall of Gas Grills to Replace Gas Pressure Regulator (On/Off Gauge)
summary: As consumers adjust the gas pressure regulator (on/off gauge) leading to the propane cylinder, the label on the valve can become positioned in such a manner that it is difficult to read. This can cause consumers to inadvertently leave the gas valve on, posing a fire hazard. Units: 10,900.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of RANGER 4x4 Utility Vehicles
summary: The lower steering shaft assembly may have a missing or misplaced weld that connects the steering wheel to the steering gear box assembly. If a weld is missing or misplaced, the lower steering shaft assembly could fail, causing the operator to lose control of the vehicle. Units: About 1,250.

title: CPSC, Tai Tung International Recall Car and Washing Machine Toys
summary: The multicolored beads inside the toys can become accessible to children, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 128,880.

title: CPSC, Chris Arlotta Enterprises Ltd. Announce Recall of Mattress Pads
summary: These mattress pads fail to meet the federal mandatory standard for flammability, under the Flammable Fabrics Act. They pose a serious risk of burn injury or death to consumers, if exposed to smoldering or burning cigarettes. Units: About 2,900.

title: CPSC, Zippo Announce Recall of Multi-Purpose Utility Lighters
summary: The utility lighters may spill fuel from the nozzle when first used, causing a potential fire hazard, through a secondary source of ignition. Units: 101,557.

title: CPSC, Avanti Products Inc. Announce Recall of Water Dispensers
summary: The hot water faucet on these units has a child-resistant safety feature to prevent young children from accessing the hot water. The device can malfunction, so that the faucet will not turn off, causing burn injuries to children. Units: About 124,000.
